changeSet.author: hephaestus
changeSet.comment: The immutable versions of a team item. An ended version keeps its row, so its sequence number is never reused. The account key comes first, because an account erasure locks the account before it reaches a team. A delete of an account row detaches only what an erasure has already ended: the submitter check refuses any other.

changeSet.author: hephaestus
changeSet.comment: The rules of team items and versions, for every writer. A new version takes share locks on its account, its submitter's team membership, the team and the item, in that order, so an erasure, a leave or a removal that runs beside it either waits and ends the version, or wins and the insert is refused. Update guards only validate, so they run after the row write.
changeSet.createProcedure: CREATE FUNCTION public.guard_team_item_version() RETURNS trigger LANGUAGE plpgsql AS $$ BEGIN IF ROW(NEW.id, NEW.workspace_id, NEW.item_id, NEW.sequence_number, NEW.submitted_at, NEW.request_key, NEW.created_in_transaction) IS DISTINCT FROM ROW(OLD.id, OLD.workspace_id, OLD.item_id, OLD.sequence_number, OLD.submitted_at, OLD.request_key, OLD.created_in_transaction) OR (NEW.submitted_by IS NOT NULL AND NEW.submitted_by IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.submitted_by) OR (NEW.title IS NOT NULL AND NEW.title IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.title) OR NEW.expires_at > OLD.expires_at OR (NEW.state IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.state AND OLD.state != 'AVAILABLE' AND NEW.state != 'ERASED') OR (NEW.state = 'AVAILABLE' AND OLD.state != 'AVAILABLE') THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'a team item version is immutable and ends once' USING ERRCODE = '23514'; END IF; RETURN NULL; END $$

CREATE FUNCTION public.withdraw_departed_team_member_versions() RETURNS trigger LANGUAGE plpgsql AS $$ BEGIN UPDATE public.team_item_version v SET state = 'WITHDRAWN', title = NULL FROM public.team_item i WHERE i.id = v.item_id AND i.workspace_id = v.workspace_id AND i.team_id = OLD.team_id AND i.workspace_id = OLD.workspace_id AND v.submitted_by = OLD.account_id AND v.state = 'AVAILABLE'; RETURN NULL; END $$

changeSet.author: hephaestus
changeSet.rollback: DROP TRIGGER team_item_version_guard ON public.team_item_version; DROP TRIGGER team_item_version_admit ON public.team_item_version;

changeSet.author: hephaestus
changeSet.comment: The strictest pending retention (P4): a person who leaves a team takes their available versions with them.
changeSet.sql: CREATE TRIGGER project_team_member_withdraws_versions AFTER DELETE ON public.project_team_member FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION public.withdraw_departed_team_member_versions();
